title.en: Domestic and international markets, government role and quality

text.en:
Anu saw a toy with a label saying 'Made in another country'.
"That came through international trade," said her mother.

Domestic markets trade goods within the country; international markets trade between countries through imports and exports. India exports tea and software and imports oil.
The government regulates markets to protect buyers, for example by setting standards, taxing goods and stopping cheating.
We assess quality by looking for marks such as ISI and BIS, checking dates and asking for bills.
